sentences.text: Jagdish S/o Bhanji, Aged About 30 Years, R/o Mahudikheda Pipaliya, Police Station Dhariyawad, Dist. Pratapgarh.

(Presently Lodged In Jail Pratapgarh)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vishnav Das Vaishnav For Respondent(s) : Mr. Hathi Singh Jodha, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MUKESH RAJPUROHIT Order 10/07/2025

This application for bail under Section 483 of BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.258/2024 registered at Police Station Dhariyawad, District Pratapgarh, for offences under Sections 64(1) of the BNS and under Section 376 of the IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel further submits that the FIR was registered against the petitioner after a period of two months from the date of incident.
Learned counsel submits that the petitioner and prosecutrix has some dispute in regard to the payment.

Learned counsel drawn attention of this Court towards the medical report issued by the [2025:RJ-JD:30066] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-3490/2025]
competent authority and as per averment there are no signs of any forceful act committed against her.
Learned counsel submits that the charge sheet has already filed in this matter.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 11.02.2025 and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused- petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 of BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Jagdish S/o Bhanji, arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.258/2024 registered at Police Station Dhariyawad, District Pratapgarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
